en-x-plain.passkey.signIn: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or phone PIN
en-x-plain.passkey.create: Make an account with your fingerprint, face or phone PIN
en-x-plain.passkey.title: How you sign in
en-x-plain.passkey.add: Add another way to sign in
en-x-plain.passkey.note: This uses your device to check it is you. You do not need to type a password.
en-x-plain.recipients.needSecond: You need a backup key as well. Add a recovery key or an SSH key.
en-x-plain.recipients.addMine: Use my fingerprint, face or PIN as a key
en-x-plain.recipients.myHint: Your device will ask you to confirm it is you. Then it can open this document. You do not type anything.
en-x-plain.recipients.recoveryWarning: This is your backup key. You see it only now. Write it down or print it, and keep it somewhere safe. We cannot get it back for you. If you lose it and your sign-in, nobody can open this document again.
en-x-plain.recipients.recoveryAck: I have put this backup key somewhere safe
en-x-plain.recipients.removed: Sharing stopped. %d saved files were locked again without that key.
en-x-plain.recipients.confirmRemove: Stop sharing with %s? From now on they cannot open what you save. They keep anything they already opened or copied. You cannot take that back.
en-x-plain.recipients.checkHint: Ask the person to read you their key code. Use a different way to ask than the way you got the key, for example a phone call. Then type the code here.
en-x-plain.recipients.labelOnly: not checked yet: check the key code
en-x-plain.dir.owner.pendingWarning: This is your new owner key. Save it now. Once the change is done, this is the only copy.
en-x-plain.links.intro: Anyone with the link gets the access you pick. The link stops working on its own, or when you turn it off. A link cannot change who else has access. It cannot delete the document.
en-x-plain.links.encProtects: The server keeps only scrambled text. It cannot read your documents. A link on its own does not give a key.
en-x-plain.links.encNot: Locking does not hide a document from someone you let in. They can read it, copy it and pass it on. It does not hide that the document exists, when it changed, or how big it is. A link works for anyone who has it.
en-x-plain.enc.err.secretNotSaved: You have not saved the backup key yet. Say that you saved it first.
en-x-plain.enc.err.passkeyOnly: Using only a fingerprint, face or PIN is not allowed, unless you accept this: if you lose it, you lose every document in this store.
en-x-plain.enc.err.wouldLoseRecovery: That would leave only your fingerprint, face or PIN. Keep a backup key or an SSH key too.
en-x-plain.enc.chooseKey: Choose at least one way to open your documents: your fingerprint, face or PIN, a backup key, or an SSH key.
en-x-plain.dir.err.rate: Too many tries. Please wait a minute and try again.
en-x-plain.dir.unenrolledNote: This address has no owner key. So only the server says this key belongs to that person. Check the key code another way, in person or by phone, before you add it.
